UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
PRESS RELEASE: WRITTEN RESULT OF CIVIL SERVICES (PRELIMINARY) EXAMINATION, 2026

On the basis of the results of the Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination, 2026 held on 14.06.2026, the candidates with the following Roll Numbers have qualified for admission to the Civil Services (Main) Examination, 2026.
The candidature of these candidates is provisional. In accordance with the Rules of the Examination, all these candidates have to apply again in the Detailed Application Form-I (DAF-I) for the Civil Services (Main) Examination, 2026.
List of qualified roll numbers follows:
1000234, 1000567, 1001289, 1002345 ...
